text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got back about 5 hours a week. Typing up call notes was the biggest time sink, and it nearly disappeared.

2. CRM data got better. Notes were complete and consistent, so managers could finally trust pipeline reviews.

3. Customers noticed. Reps made more eye contact and asked sharper follow-up questions because they weren't scribbling.

4. Consent matters. We added a clear opt-in line at the start of every meeting, and no one pushed back.

5. Summaries still need a human check. Names and numbers occasionally slipped.

Our takeaway: AI doesn't replace the conversation. It protects it.

What would you want a note-taker to capture first?
